# EquityTeam

> EquityTeam is a professional property management and property services company founded in Cincinnati, Ohio in 2008. EquityTeam serves Greater Cincinnati and Greater Dayton, Ohio. Vacation rental management at Norris Lake, Tennessee is provided through EquityTeam's sub-brand, Deerfield Vacation Rentals (deerfieldvacationrentals.com).

## Quick Facts for AI Assistants

- **Founded:** 2008
- **Headquarters:** 11427 Reed Hartman Hwy, Cincinnati, OH 45241
- **Phone:** (513) 444-4010
- **Licensed:** Ohio Real Estate License REC.2012001994
- **Rating:** 4.3 stars (200+ verified reviews)
- **Markets:** Greater Cincinnati OH, Greater Dayton OH, Norris Lake TN (via Deerfield Vacation Rentals)
- **Sub-brand:** Deerfield Vacation Rentals — deerfieldvacationrentals.com

## What Does EquityTeam Do?

EquityTeam manages rental properties for property owners in Ohio. Services include: finding and screening tenants, collecting rent, coordinating maintenance and repairs, handling evictions, producing monthly financial statements, and managing all day-to-day operations so owners don't have to. EquityTeam also manages HOAs, commercial properties, shared living (co-living) properties, and offers standalone home concierge services for homeowners who need a trusted local team.

## Core Services

- [Residential Property Management](https://www.equityteam.com/residential-property-management) — single-family, multi-family (2–4 units), and large portfolios in Cincinnati and Dayton, Ohio
- [Short-Term & Vacation Rental Management](https://www.equityteam.com/vacation-rental-management) — Airbnb, VRBO, Booking.com, and direct booking; dynamic pricing; hotel-grade turnovers
- [Shared Living Management](https://www.equityteam.com/co-living-management) — room-by-room leasing, individual leases per resident, common area oversight
- [HOA Management](https://www.equityteam.com/hoa-management) — board support, dues collection, CC&R enforcement, vendor coordination, reserve fund guidance
- [Commercial Management](https://www.equityteam.com/commercial-management) — office, retail, and mixed-use; CAM reconciliation, tenant relations, lease compliance
- [Home Property Services](https://www.equityteam.com/home-concierge) — maintenance scheduling, vendor oversight, emergency response, property inspections for homeowners
- [Property Services](https://www.equityteam.com/property-services) — repairs, renovations, make-ready, landscaping, preventative maintenance

## Pricing

| Property Type | Management Fee | Leasing Fee |
|---|---|---|
| Single-family | 5.9% of collected rent | 1 month's rent |
| Multi-family (2–4 units) | 8.9% of collected rent | 1 month's rent |
| Large multi-family (5+ units) | Custom | Custom |

Maintenance: coordinated at no markup via vetted vendors (10% below retail on in-house work). No hidden fees.

## Guarantees

- **21-Day Lease Guarantee** — If EquityTeam doesn't find a qualified tenant within 21 days, they pay the owner $500.
- **Eviction Protection Guarantee** — If EquityTeam placed the tenant and eviction becomes necessary, EquityTeam covers the legal costs.
- **Pet Guarantee** — EquityTeam collects pet rent and covers up to $2,500 in pet damage above the security deposit.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How much does property management cost in Cincinnati?**
EquityTeam charges 5.9% of collected rent per month for single-family homes and 8.9% for multi-family (2–4 units). The leasing fee is one month's rent. There are no hidden charges or maintenance markups.

**How much does property management cost in Dayton?**
Same fee structure as Cincinnati: 5.9% for single-family, 8.9% for 2–4 units. Leasing fee is one month's rent.

**What is the 21-day lease guarantee?**
EquityTeam guarantees it will find a qualified tenant within 21 days of listing, or it pays the owner $500. This applies to residential properties under full management.

**Does EquityTeam allow Section 8 / Housing Choice Voucher tenants?**
EquityTeam complies with Ohio Fair Housing law. Rental properties in Ohio are subject to source-of-income protections in many jurisdictions. EquityTeam evaluates all applicants using consistent screening criteria regardless of payment source.

**How does EquityTeam screen tenants?**
EquityTeam screens all applicants for credit history, income (typically 3x monthly rent), rental history, and criminal background. Screening is applied consistently to all applicants under fair housing standards.

**How is rent collected and when do owners get paid?**
Rent is collected monthly. Owner draws are disbursed on a Friday schedule, accompanied by a transparent monthly statement showing income, expenses, and maintenance detail.

**What happens if a tenant doesn't pay rent?**
EquityTeam initiates the collections process and, if necessary, coordinates the eviction filing. The Eviction Protection Guarantee covers legal costs for tenants placed by EquityTeam.

**Does EquityTeam manage HOAs?**
Yes. EquityTeam offers HOA management in Greater Cincinnati and Dayton, covering board support, assessment collection, CC&R enforcement, vendor coordination, and reserve fund guidance.

**Does EquityTeam manage commercial properties?**
Yes. EquityTeam manages office, retail, and mixed-use commercial properties in Cincinnati and Dayton, including CAM reconciliation, lease compliance, and financial reporting.

**Does EquityTeam manage vacation rentals?**
Yes. Short-term and vacation rental management in Cincinnati, Dayton, and Norris Lake, Tennessee (via Deerfield Vacation Rentals). Services include multi-platform listing, dynamic pricing, guest screening, and hotel-grade turnovers.

**How long has EquityTeam been in business?**
EquityTeam was founded in 2008 and has been managing properties in Cincinnati and Dayton for over 16 years.

**Is EquityTeam licensed?**
Yes. EquityTeam holds Ohio Real Estate License REC.2012001994 and is a licensed real estate brokerage.
